import json
G=load()
def solve(inp):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # non-bg cells
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bg]
    # marker = color appearing as isolated single cells, majority count
    from collections import defaultdict
    colcnt=Counter(inp[r][c] for r,c in cells)
    # sprite color(s) = minority colors forming contiguous block; marker color = most frequent non-bg
    marker_col=max(colcnt, key=lambda k:colcnt[k])
    sprite=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if inp[r][c]!=marker_col]
    rs=[r for r,c in sprite]; cs=[c for r,c in sprite]
